created_round: R408 (external-audit instruction 6: 'P04/P11 need reality, not more software; P11 is the cleanest first physical experiment — decision contract already frozen')
purpose: THE single operator-facing document for the portfolio's FIRST physical experiment: everything a funded bench operator needs to run P11's pre-registered protocol and return data through the reality-ingestion interface, and everything the machine will do with the result. NO new machinery was built for this runsheet (Art. XXXIV: reality, not software — every machine-side capability named below already existed and is verified green at this commit).
constitutional_basis: Art. XXXIV (stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck — this runsheet is documentation of the frozen state, not new instrumentation)
Art. XXXVIII (the reality boundary: the observation enters ONLY as a REALITY_EVENT with provenance; CONTROLLED_REHEARSAL can never promote)
Art. LII (the killer experiment is a falsification contract — the kill rules below are frozen, not negotiable at the bench)
Art. XXVII (every threshold below carries its registered provenance class; no post-hoc change is legal — any change voids the run)

why_p11_is_first.the_audit_basis: the R408 external audit's verdict: P11 is the cleanest first physical experiment — its decision contract is frozen, its cost is the lowest of the four leads, its kill conditions are registered with statistical form, and its differentiators map one-to-one onto measurable bench endpoints
why_p11_is_first.cost_and_time: $15K / 8 weeks (R339-RECORDED for this exact protocol class; wider REPORTED context $15-38K)
why_p11_is_first.compare: P04's bench is comparable in class but its primary differentiator is an obstruction-survivability protocol with a 12-week SNR-bench work package; P08 requires the D2 owner decision BEFORE its bench is decisive; P13's spend is frozen permanent (learning artifact)

the_frozen_contract.question: What is the cheapest credible way to learn whether this technology deserves more money?
the_frozen_contract.hypothesis: Across the physiological postural pressure set, the hydraulic damper beats the ASD baseline on the two pre-declared unestablished differentiators — response time to a postural pressure step and proportional (continuous) flow modulation
the_frozen_contract.treatment_arm: the damper element (annular-gap architecture, shipped 0.18 mm gap class) inline in the mock CSF loop
the_frozen_contract.control_arms: TWO control arms on the identical bench loop (Art. XLVII — the baseline is MEASURED, identical instrument, unchanged across arms): (1) ASD — the incumbent real baseline; (2) per the frozen DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json
the_frozen_contract.apparatus: mock CSF loop (R339-recorded protocol): pressure-head reservoir programmable across 10/20/30/40 mmHg postural pressures, flow sensor, postural-step actuation (step profile representative of the 1-3 s physiological transition), continuous flow + pressure acquisition; blinded analysis by the committed script

endpoint_1.name: response time to postural pressure step
endpoint_1.definition: time from postural pressure step to flow settling within 10% of steady state (per run)
endpoint_1.claim_under_test: damper settles 0.1 s faster than ASD (MODELLED: tau = I_h/c_h; 0.4 s vs 0.5 s class)
endpoint_1.MDD_provenance: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P11/INSTRUMENT_MDD_CALCULATION.json (the claimed 0.1 s difference is 3.95x the MDD — DETECTABLE)
endpoint_1.kill_condition_A: the response-speed differentiator is NOT established — KILL unless endpoint 2 is decisively positive — if the damper's mean settling time is not >= 20% faster than the ASD arm (registered rule)

endpoint_2.name: proportional flow modulation error
endpoint_2.definition: mean absolute deviation of instantaneous flow from the linear-in-pressure target trajectory across the step (per run)
endpoint_2.claim_under_test: the damper modulates flow proportionally/continuously where the ASD acts stepwise
endpoint_2.kill_condition_B: the safety case is negative — KILL — if the damper's target-flow accuracy is statistically worse than the ASD arm at ANY tested pressure (paired one-sided, alpha 0.05, Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired per-pressure means, n=10 pairs)

statistical_analysis_plan.primary: per-endpoint, per-pressure paired comparisons (damper vs ASD), one-sided, alpha = 0.05, n = 10 pairs per comparison
statistical_analysis_plan.multiplicity: the four pressures are REPORTED per-pressure (no pooled override); a pooled verdict requires the same direction in >= 3 of 4 pressures (registered)
statistical_analysis_plan.no_data_peeking: all thresholds frozen; the analysis script is committed BEFORE any run (the R339 blinded-analysis harness)
statistical_analysis_plan.post_hoc_rule: any post-collection change to a registered threshold VOIDS the run (Art. XXVII)

honest_limits_inherited: mock loop fluid is water/CSF-mimic (NIST 310.15 K viscosity class; CSF residual disclosed)
excludes biological fouling and in-vivo compliance
clinical materiality of the settling difference is NOT established by this bench (engineering materiality only)
commercial ASD device tolerances may differ from the modeled ASD profile (why a REAL ASD is the comparator)

mandatory_fields.experiment_id: the frozen experiment contract id this observation answers (binds the observation to its pre-registered thresholds)
mandatory_fields.apparatus_id: physical apparatus identity (serial/registry id; 'UNKNOWN' is legitimate, BLANK is not)
mandatory_fields.operator: the human/instrument operator of record (identity + organization; 'UNKNOWN' is legitimate, blank is not)
mandatory_fields.source_type: EXTERNAL_HUMAN or EXTERNAL_INSTRUMENT (NEVER 'CONTROLLED_REHEARSAL' for real data — rehearsal events are machine-rejected from promotion)
mandatory_fields.raw_data_hash: sha256 of the RAW acquisition bytes BEFORE any processing (the attestation binds to this)
mandatory_fields.processed_data_hash: sha256 of the processed dataset (the processing script must itself be committed — the raw->processed step is part of custody)
mandatory_fields.measurement_units: explicit units for every measured quantity (bare numbers are REJECTED at ingestion)
mandatory_fields.baseline_result: the CONTROL-arm result (the ASD arm — measured, never assumed)
mandatory_fields.candidate_result: the TREATMENT-arm result, structured per the frozen endpoint schema
mandatory_fields.pre_registered_threshold: the threshold set the decision was computed against (must HASH-MATCH the frozen contract's registered values)
mandatory_fields.decision: the machine verdict computed by the frozen contract's decision function decide_p11 — {verdict, rule_id, rule_trace}; free-text decisions are REJECTED at ingestion

how_to_return_the_result.attestation_and_custody: per Art. XXXVIII: raw artifact -> sha256 -> acquisition attestation (instrument identity, serial, calibration record, operator, organization, protocol, timestamp, custody chain, signature) -> append-only ledger (LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P11/REALITY_LOOP/REALITY_LEDGER.json, prev_entry_sha256 chained; duplicate event_ids rejected; verify_ledger() detects any mutation of a past entry)
how_to_return_the_result.fabrication_guards: the ingestion contract's anti-fabrication guards apply (no observation without provenance; AI/computation-sourced events are structurally rejected from PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION class)

what_the_machine_does_with_the_first_rea.step_1_validation: validate_reality_event_v2 checks every mandatory field, the units, the threshold hash-match, and the decision structure
what_the_machine_does_with_the_first_rea.step_2_ingestion: the event enters the append-only REALITY_LEDGER with full custody
what_the_machine_does_with_the_first_rea.step_3_loop_promotion: discovery_fabric/engine/loop_chain.py advances P11's loop state from PREDICTION (NO_PHYSICAL_DATA) on the REALITY_EVENT alone — no narrative, no manual assignment (the R406 adversarial tests prove rehearsal/malformed events CANNOT promote)
what_the_machine_does_with_the_first_rea.step_4_decision: decide_p11 applies the frozen rule set: SUPPORTED / MIXED / KILLED / EXECUTION_INVALID (an infrastructure or protocol violation is EXECUTION_INVALID, never a scientific rejection — Art. LXI)
what_the_machine_does_with_the_first_rea.step_5_model_update: MODEL_UPDATE_LEDGER.json (armed, currently AWAITING_PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION): prediction_before / actual_measurement / error_before / model_update / prediction_after / error_after — MODEL_IMPROVED requires movement PLUS held-out improvement, never self-declared
what_the_machine_does_with_the_first_rea.step_6_next_search_changes: the loop's discovery constraint update changes subsequent prediction/search — THIS is the milestone the R408 audit defined as the first real closed-loop traversal

machine_side_preconditions_verified_at_t.model_update_ledger_armed: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P11/MODEL_UPDATE_LEDGER.json — state AWAITING_PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION, every field present, actual_measurement null until a REALITY_EVENT arrives
machine_side_preconditions_verified_at_t.loop_chain_armed: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P11/LOOP_CHAIN.json — currently held at PREDICTION (NO_PHYSICAL_DATA); promotion is REALITY_EVENT-gated by machine rule
machine_side_preconditions_verified_at_t.adversarial_rehearsal_protection: tests/test_r406_real_loop.py proves CONTROLLED_REHEARSAL never promotes, malformed events are rejected, and model-update verdicts require held-out improvement
machine_side_preconditions_verified_at_t.novelty_state_honest: NOVELTY_ASSESSMENT.json SUPPORTED with committed search custody

what_is_missing_the_machine_cannot_suppl.bench_and_operator: a physical mock-CSF-loop bench, a real ASD comparator, and an operator of record
what_is_missing_the_machine_cannot_suppl.the_observation_itself: the machine's honest headline unchanged: physical_observation_count = 0 until reality produces the evidence (Art. XXXVIII — AI may not claim that reality happened unless reality produced the evidence)

explicitly_not_claimed: the portfolio does NOT claim a closed-loop discovery system. The decisive milestone remains: real experiment -> raw measurement -> provenance -> comparison with preregistered prediction -> model error -> model update -> changed subsequent prediction/search. This runsheet exists so the first traversal has zero machine-side friction when the owner funds the bench.
